statement: The original broad H1—crossing graph DP granularity with empirical attacks—is insufficiently novel as a standalone final-project contribution because important cells are already covered: node-DP versus node membership inference, edge-DP versus graph-level topology inference, and graph-structure-aware membership auditing.
notes: The matrix remains useful as a survey/benchmark scaffold, but novelty requires a much narrower unmatched cell or methodological contribution.
